title: DCP Plugin Configuration
description: Dynamic tiered context compression for OpenCode: request-time folding plus semantic checkpoint quality for the host's own compaction

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor autocomplete

autoUpdate.description: Show a non-destructive notification when a newer package is available

enabled.description: Dynamic tiered compression: fold the outgoing model request by recency tiers, never touching the session or its state machine

tailTurns.description: Conversation turns at the end that are never folded (kept verbatim)

lowWatermarkRatio.description: Fraction of the context window below which no folding happens at all

targetRatio.description: Folding escalates (distant → middle → current) until the estimate fits this fraction of the context window

driftThreshold.description: Jaccard similarity below which consecutive user messages count as a topic change (starts the protected current-task zone)

toolOutputKeepChars.description: Current-zone tool outputs longer than this are head+tail truncated

mergeRuns.description: Validity-axis merging: repeated and failed tool runs in the middle/distant zones collapse to one surviving call, with counts kept in a _merged meta key

enabled.description: Register the model-invokable dcp_prune tool (marks a topic boundary and deepens folding; instant, never interrupts)
